about: Accepted hardware reports for lordos.org/hardware and the Compatibility panel's snapshot (tools/hwreport/catalog.mjs). A community report is added here, with its issue number, only after a maintainer accepted it. The two reports below are the project's own reference machines ("source": "reference"), not community reports: VM 116's system section is its real report (lordos-sysreport report --json, 2026-10-29) and the Raspberry Pi 5 16 GB's is written from the documented machine (docs/BENCHMARK.md, docs/RASPBERRY.md) until a captured report replaces it; both carry the LordBench numbers of apps/sysinfo/references.js.
